thread:
Ava: quick flag from design review: the compact action bar on the SLO card (min/max, burst, pool) looks tight on small modal widths. the save button gets pushed off-screen in some cases.
Ravi: saw that in staging. on 360px it forces horizontal scroll which is bad. screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/22876
Noor: accessibility note: if save becomes off-screen, keyboard users can still tab to it, but visual users may miss it. prefer collapsing less-critical actions into an overflow menu.
Jun: proposal: keep primary actions (min/max slider and save) full width; move pool + burst into a compact secondary row or an inline overflow (kebab) when width < 420px.
Maya: agree with prioritizing save. also add a persistent visible hint when overflowed: a small pill that says "More controls" with aria-expanded state so screen readers know there's hidden content.
Ava: can we prototype an inline kebab that reveals pool + burst panel? it should be reachable by keyboard and keep logical tab order: slider -> save -> kebab -> (pool, burst).
Ravi: implement with a button "<button aria-haspopup=\"menu\" aria-expanded=\"false\">⋯</button>" and render a focus-trap menu with pool and burst. menu items should be `role=menuitem` and keyboard navigable.
Noor: also ensure when the menu opens we announce via aria-live: "More controls expanded" and that closing returns focus to the kebab button. test with VoiceOver.
Jun: i'll mock up CSS to switch to overflow at 420px: `.action-bar { display:flex; gap:8px; } @media (max-width:420px) { .action-bar { flex-wrap:nowrap; } .kebab { display:inline-flex; } }`
Maya: microtest: 1) shrink modal to 360px, 2) tab to save, 3) open kebab, 4) enable burst via keyboard. record any focus issues.
ux-bot: created branch ux/slo-actionbar-overflow-22876 and uploaded mock: slo_action_overflow.png
Ava: thanks. Jun, please attach the prototype screenshots and i'll schedule a 10-min accessibility microtest with Noor and two engineers tomorrow.
Noor: will run keyboard/VoiceOver pass and report any ARIA gaps. cheers.
